heading: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

tree.heading: Office of Director of National Intelligence
tree.text: There is an Office of the Director of National Intelligence.

tree.heading: Function
tree.text: The function of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence is to assist the Director of National Intelligence in carrying out the duties and responsibilities of the Director under this Act and other applicable provisions of law, and to carry out such other duties as may be prescribed by the President or by law.

tree.heading: Composition
tree.text: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence is composed of the following:

children.text: The Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence.
Any Deputy Director of National Intelligence appointed under section 3026 of this title.
The Director of Science and Technology.
The Director of the National Counterintelligence and Security Center.
The Chief Information Officer of the Intelligence Community.
The Inspector General of the Intelligence Community.
The Director of the National Counterterrorism Center.
The Director of the National Counter Proliferation Center.1
The Chief Financial Officer of the Intelligence Community.
Such other offices and officials as may be established by law or the Director may establish or designate in the Office.

To assist the Director of National Intelligence in fulfilling the duties and responsibilities of the Director, the Director shall employ and utilize in the Office of the Director of National Intelligence a professional staff having an expertise in matters relating to such duties and responsibilities, and may establish permanent positions and appropriate rates of pay with respect to that staff.

The staff of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence under paragraph (1) shall include the staff of the Office of the Deputy Director of Central Intelligence for Community Management that is transferred to the Office of the Director of National Intelligence under section 1091 of the National Security Intelligence Reform Act of 2004.

tree.heading: Temporary filling of vacancies
tree.text: With respect to filling temporarily a vacancy in an office within the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (other than that of the Director of National Intelligence), section 3345(a)(3) of title 5 may be applied—

children.text: in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by substituting “an element of the intelligence community, as that term is defined in section 3(4) of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 401a(4)),” 2 for “such Executive agency”; and
in subparagraph (A), by substituting “the intelligence community” for “such agency”.

tree.heading: Location of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence
tree.text: The headquarters of the Office of the Director of National Intelligence may be located in the Washington metropolitan region, as that term is defined in section 8301 of title 40.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This Act, referred to in subsec. (b), probably means Pub. L. 108–458, Dec. 17, 2004, 118 Stat. 3638, known as the Intelligence Reform and Terrorism Prevention Act of 2004. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Tables. Section 1091 of the National Security Intelligence Reform Act of 2004, referred to in subsec. (d)(2), is section 1091 of Pub. L. 108–458, which is set out as a note under section 3001 of this title. Section 3 of the National Security Act of 1947, referred to in subsec. (e)(1), was classified to section 401a of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as section 3003 of this title.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 403–3 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section. Some section numbers of this title referenced in amendment notes below reflect the classification of such sections prior to their editorial reclassification.

notes.heading: Mission Manager for the People’s Republic of China
notes.text: Pub. L. 119–60, div. F, title LXVII, § 6707, Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1648, provided that: “(a) Establishment of Position.—“(1) In general.—There shall be a mission manager for all intelligence collection matters relating to the People’s Republic of China. The mission manager shall be designated or appointed by the Director of National Intelligence. “(2) Rule of construction.—Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the mission manager designated or appointed under paragraph (1) may be an individual serving in a position within the Office of the Director of National Intelligence. “(b) Applicability.—The first mission manager under subsection (a) shall be designated or appointed not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act [Dec. 18, 2025]. “(c) Termination.—This section shall terminate on December 31, 2030.”
